synthesis.climate_context: Insufficient local data — recommend manual research
synthesis.building_stock: Both Newport VIC records describe doors that are not a standard hinged single entry leaf. A Newport VIC 3015 job dated 14 Jan 2025 is a bifold door still carrying an old mortise lock, with the smart lock to go in as that mortise's replacement — a narrow folding leaf, not a solid entry door (Airtasker West Melbourne page, Newport VIC 3015 record). A second Newport VIC job pairs a front-door Eufy E110 install with a lockable door handle for a bathroom, so internal doors sit in scope beside the front door in the same visit (Airtasker Newport VIC). Beyond 'bifold', 'front door' and 'bathroom', the returned records establish nothing about Newport's dwelling construction — no heritage timber, apartment common entrances, new-estate composite or double-glazed sliders appear — so door substrate and thickness remain unestablished for this suburb.
synthesis.demographic_skew: The two Newport VIC records show opposite buyer states in the same suburb. One householder has already settled on an exact model — the Eufy E110 — and wants only a fitter, and is looking for a 'skilled handyman' rather than a locksmith (Airtasker Newport VIC). The other had not bought a lock at all as at 14 Jan 2025 and asked for advice on which one to buy that would be 'easiest to replace' on their existing door (Airtasker West Melbourne page, Newport VIC 3015 record). Both routed the work through a general-task marketplace rather than approaching a locksmith directly. Nothing in the returned records establishes tenure, household composition or income for Newport, so renter/owner mix and turnover are not evidenced.
common_concerns: Whether a smart lock can replace an old mortise lock on a bifold door — the Newport VIC 3015 job dated 14 Jan 2025 is exactly that retrofit, not a standard entry-door swap (Airtasker West Melbourne page, Newport VIC 3015 record).

Which smart lock to buy in the first place: the same Newport VIC 3015 customer had not purchased one yet and wanted advice on the model 'easiest to replace' on their door, so product selection is part of the job rather than settled before it (Airtasker West Melbourne page, Newport VIC 3015 record).
Whether an already-chosen consumer model can be fitted as-is — a Newport VIC job names the Eufy E110 and specifies it goes on the front door (Airtasker Newport VIC).

Who supplies the hardware, and whether internal doors are covered in the same visit: the Newport VIC job instructs the tradesperson 'You must bring a door handle that locks for bathrooms' alongside the front-door smart lock (Airtasker Newport VIC).
